description: 南部科學園區管理局道路統計資料 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 國家科學及技術委員會南部科學園區管理局. 配合政府資料開放政策，提供南科園區內道路資料，諸如道路面積、長度等數量資料。 瞭解園區內道路長度、面積等基礎交通設施。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 國家科學及技術委員會南部科學園區管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
